tekst:
By Aris Barkas / barkas@eurohoops.net
Olympiacos will host Dubai on Thursday at 20:15 CEST in Athens, but Xavi Pascual’s team will be without Thomas Walkup for the game.
The naturalized Greek guard made his biggest mark at Olympiacos, with whom he won the EuroLeague a few months ago. However, his time with the Piraeus club ended on a sour note.
Everyone was waiting for his return in front of the Olympiacos fans, but that will not happen. Thomas Walkup is injured, will miss the game, and will not travel to Greece at all.
“Per sources Dubai’s Thomas Walkup is going to miss the game vs Olympiacos due to injury and will not travel to Greece this week.”
Walkup last played for Dubai on October 19 in the ABA League, when he recorded three points and six assists in a victory over Studentski Centar. He has been out of the team since then. He also did not travel to Bologna last week and was not with the team in Belgrade for the ABA League weekend game.
